correctness.rationale: Two direct stubborn Poisson maps at rate a and two directed mutual averaging maps at rate m define bounded Feller jump process. Alternating two stubborn interactions synchronously contract both coordinate differences and occur with positive probability, proving unique invariant law even at m=0. Reconstructed the generator on x,y,x²,xy,y² and solved its symbolic linear system; the stationarity identities give EX=u/(1+2u), EY=(1+u)/(1+2u), common variance theta*u*(1+u)^2/[(1+2u)^2((2-theta)+(4-3theta)u)]. Independent symbolic derivative matches theta(1+u)[(2-theta)(1+u)-4(1-theta)u²] over positive denominator. For 0<theta<1 the quadratic has exactly one positive root; at theta=1 derivative remains positive. Mean gap is monotone and finite optimum diverges with scaling limit 1/4.
residual_risks: No extrapolation to heterogeneous networks or empirical opinion dynamics.
